title: The Boston molasses flood
caption:
A company found leaks in its giant syrup tank, so it painted the tank brown. 🍯
An overstressed steel tank split and released a wave of molasses that thickened as it cooled, trapping everything it reached.
What's the worst 'fix' you've ever seen?
sources: Wikipedia, Great Molasses Flood (Boston, 15 January 1919; tank of about 8.7 million litres; wave up to about 7.6 m at about 56 km/h; 21 killed; tank painted brown to hide leaks; the company blamed anarchists; the court found against it)
